cases.description: Find a seeded cross-customer authorization regression without inventing unrelated findings.
cases.prompt: Use the code-review skill to review head {head} against base {base}. Return the normal PR-style review and do not modify files.
manual_rubric: Explains that any signed-in user can view an invoice belonging to another customer because a non-empty customerId is treated as authorization.
Cites the changed return expression in src/auth.js and suggests comparing invoice.customerId with user.id.
Notes the missing non-owner regression case without turning the review into a generic testing lecture.
Does not report preference-only or unrelated issues.

cases.description: Avoid false-positive findings on a small, specified, fully tested change.
cases.prompt: Use the code-review skill to review head {head} against base {base}. Be strict about the finding quality bar. Do not modify files.
manual_rubric: Checks the README contract and tests before concluding the change is clean.
Does not speculate about unsupported requirements such as accepting fractional page sizes.
Reports actual verification and residual risk concisely.

cases.description: Find a small human-authored transfer defect inside a noisy generated-file refresh and report review coverage honestly.
cases.prompt: Use the code-review skill to review head {head} against base {base}. The generated catalog files are expected output, but review the complete PR scope and do not modify files.
manual_rubric: Separates generated catalog noise from the human-authored transfer validation change.
Explains that zero or negative transfers now pass when they are below the balance.
Does not pretend to deeply review every generated value and reports any coverage limitation honestly.
